kind: deterministic logger delivery preflight, not agent evidence

budget.rationale: 100 sites per synthetic packet; B limits declared deep investigations to ten. 256 KiB permits complete audit output plus navigation; it is a delivery guardrail, not a tuned treatment advantage. Time/site/action caps need unrelated agent calibration and review before scored execution.
budget.stopping: Reject new deep sites after B; already-started site work and final output may continue within byte/time/request caps. No evaluator-gold early stop. A finding timestamp records all counters at submission.
budget.measurement_limit: Logger enforces calls routed through it. Shared-filesystem bypass and covert reasoning cannot be physically prevented or fully observed here.
